items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I notice that you have 'Louisiana' on here by J. Johnson and Andy Razaf M. Do you know that Andy Razaf is here in the hospital and very near death right now? Oh no!

ctx.x: Well they didn't know. They didn't know.

But they really had to keep up the illusion there. I was looking at this album of yours called 'Shades of Bix'. And I notice that you have 'Louisiana' on here by J. Johnson and Andy Razaf M. Do you know that Andy Razaf
is here in the hospital and very near death right now?
